prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In & Keep Your Desktop Pet Safe", "Log in with your existing account to restore your pet collection and save state automatically.", "Account Sync Active"]
1: ["Desktop Pet Controls", "Learn how to summon, interact, and manage your pet directly from your desktop system tray.", "Got It, Launch Pet", "Your Companion is Ready!"]
2: ["Welcome to Your Virtual Desktop Companion", "Choose how you want to bring your desktop pet to life—select a premade companion or create a custom pet."]
3: ["Official Pet Adoption & Naming", "Give your desktop pet a custom name before bringing them onto your desktop.", "Enter Pet Name", "Official Adoption Certificate"]
4: ["Tip: Make sure your system tray allows background apps so your pet can roam freely on screen."]
5: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop", "Right-click the tray icon anytime to chat, hide, or adjust pet settings.", "Start Playing"]
6: ["Choose Your Ready-to-Adopt Companion", "Select a pet persona below to immediately generate your desktop friend.", "You can change pet skins and personalities later in desktop settings."]
7: ["How Would You Like to Start?", "Pick an existing pet design for quick setup, or upload your own photos to create a custom pet.", "Continue"]
8: ["Be sure to sign in with the same email used on other devices to sync existing pets.", "Sign In to Sync"]
9: ["Bringing Your Pet to Life...", "Your companion is being rendered and configured for desktop animations. This takes under a minute."]
